gaps.detail: Resolve zlib header 1.2.11 / README 1.2.5 / LICENSE prelude 1.2.4 before claiming a single upstream version. Preserve all three raw pins.

OTS, Skia, Blink/Chromium/Main, adapted ICU and subsidiary versions remain unknown where no local exact provenance exists. Obtain upstream revision/patch evidence; do not infer from notice filenames or engine family names.

OTS, IJG and curl recovered notices are retained, but absent original accompanying source LICENSE/README/COPYING files prevent direct current-source byte equality. Current declarations and recovered texts are separately pinned.

Basename candidate matches do not evaluate MSBuild conditions, preprocessor branches, PCH/header code, generated-resource contents, linker folding or renamed objects. Preserve ambiguous and unmatched members; inspect raw compile/link inputs where needed.

This is a bounded component crosswalk, not exhaustive transitive inventory. Header/inline/vendor resource material, adapted files, V8/Skia/WebKit/OpenSSL subsidiary notices and CRT/Windows SDK provider inputs still need complete per-binary review.
Current Source2 live bytes and exact MAPs are bound, but the eleven libraries were reused. This collection does not add historical whole-provider archive byte provenance or perform new recompilation.

This archive covers the native kernel member/source crosswalk only. Installed SDK, Starter, Workbench, JavaScript/inspector assets, WebView2/CRT and future-version notice delivery require their own exact payload evidence and complete terms mapping; historic six-package 0.5.0 notice equality is not reclassified as 0.6.0 package approval.

Maintainer must identify the responsible reviewer and review applicable obligations, combined redistribution terms and release approval. No reviewer, license choice for subsidiary alternatives, legal opinion or approval is fabricated.
